user.title: HAWGCS Plugin Store
user.description:
The Gitee repository address uses the default value, no need to modify.

If you encounter 403 errors (request rate limit exceeded), please fill in a Gitee Personal Access Token to get a higher call quota. The Token is optional, you can also add it later in Settings.

data_description.token: When accessing the Gitee repository, if you encounter 403 errors (request rate limit exceeded), fill in your Gitee Personal Access Token here. Leave empty to use anonymous access (rate limited). The Token can also be added later in Settings.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of HAWGCS is allowed.

init.description:
Gitee Personal Access Token (optional).

When you encounter 403 errors (request rate limit exceeded) while accessing the repository, fill in the Token to continue. Leave empty to use anonymous access (rate limited).
